notes: JACAR vol. 2 lists the 20th Independent Mountain Artillery Battalion among the withdrawing forces, complete by 8 February 1943. Miller, chapter VI, had placed the battalion in Kawaguchi’s October right wing, but also records that the enveloping force abandoned its artillery on the inland march, so no Bloody Ridge assault claim is added.
